coverage.headline: Poolin Cleared To Pursue Asset Sale Amid Trustee Fight
coverage.summary: A New Jersey bankruptcy judge cleared Poolin Technology to proceed with its planned next-month asset sale, granting stalking-horse bidder Thor CALAP LLC additional time to also pursue a neighboring property for an AI data center in Texas. The ruling came despite the ongoing creditor trustee dispute.

coverage.headline: Poolin Cleared To Pursue Asset Sale Amid Trustee Fight
coverage.summary: A New Jersey bankruptcy judge cleared cryptocurrency miner Poolin Technology to pursue a sale of its assets next month, giving stalking-horse bidder Thor CALAP LLC time to also evaluate a neighboring property for an AI data center in Texas. The ruling came despite the pending creditor motion seeking appointment of a Chapter 11 trustee.

coverage.headline: Poolin Creditor Seeks Ch. 11 Trustee To Probe Transfers
coverage.summary: A creditor of bankrupt cryptocurrency miner Poolin Technology moved for the appointment of a Chapter 11 trustee, alleging the company's principal absconded from China to the U.S. with customer funds.

coverage.headline: Poolin owes wallet users $163.7M, and its $52M Texas sale can still unravel next week
coverage.summary: A fresh docket review finds that stalking-horse buyer Thor CALAP LLC can terminate either purchase agreement over unsatisfactory diligence through August 9, five days before the court's scheduled August 14 bidding-procedures hearing, leaving creditor recovery deeply uncertain for 11,700 IOU holders owed $163.7 million.

coverage.headline: New Chapter 11 Bankruptcy Filing — Poolin Technology PTE LTD
coverage.summary: Petition's legal trade newsletter covers the July 22 Chapter 11 filing before Judge O'Hagan in the District of New Jersey, noting that Poolin—a Singapore-registered company that once operated China's largest crypto mining pool—is represented by Archer & Greiner PC with Michael DuFrayne of DuFrayne LLC serving as CRO, financial advisor, and investment banker.

coverage.headline: Poolin Was Bitcoin's Biggest Mining Pool and Now It's Filing for Bankruptcy
coverage.summary: CoinDesk covers Poolin's Chapter 11 filing in New Jersey, detailing how the firm once held an 18–20% share of global Bitcoin hashrate before a 2022 liquidity crisis left 11,700 customers holding $163.7 million in frozen funds, with a $52 million stalking-horse bid from Thor CALAP LLC now the primary creditor recovery vehicle.

coverage.headline: Poolin, Once One of Bitcoin's Biggest Mining Pools, Files for Bankruptcy
coverage.summary: Poolin Technology Pte. Ltd. and its U.S. affiliates Lonestar Dream Inc. and Lonestar Taproot LLC filed voluntary Chapter 11 petitions in the U.S. Bankruptcy Court for the District of New Jersey, with court documents listing over $100 million in prepetition obligations against less than $10 million in assets.

coverage.headline: Bitcoin mining giant Poolin files for bankruptcy owing 11,700 users $164 million
coverage.summary: CryptoSlate reports that Poolin's first-day declaration lists $163,723,500 in unsecured wallet-holder IOUs and a proposed sale process including a September 8 qualified-offer deadline, a September 10 auction if multiple qualified bids emerge, a sale hearing no later than September 16, and a November 30 closing deadline.

coverage.headline: Bitcoin Miner Poolin Technology Files Chapter 11 With $173M Debt as $52M Asset Sale Moves Forward
coverage.summary: Poolin permanently halted all mining and hosting operations on July 10, 2026, and filed Chapter 11 on July 22 with plans to liquidate its West Texas mining infrastructure through a $52 million floor bid, leaving 11,700 wallet holders with $163.7 million in frozen IOUs.

coverage.headline: Bitcoin mining pool Poolin files for Chapter 11 bankruptcy
coverage.summary: Cointelegraph reports that Singapore-based Poolin and two U.S. affiliates filed Chapter 11 in New Jersey, listing $100M–$500M in liabilities and seeking court approval to sell two West Texas mining sites to Thor CALAP LLC under a $52 million stalking-horse bid subject to a September 8 auction deadline.

coverage.headline: Crypto Miner Poolin Hits Ch. 11 After China Ban, Market Slump
coverage.summary: Law360 reports that Bitcoin miner Poolin Technology filed for Chapter 11 protection in New Jersey bankruptcy court with more than $173 million in liabilities and plans for an asset sale, citing price volatility and the China mining ban as contributing factors.

coverage.headline: Poolin, Once One of Bitcoin's Biggest Mining Pools, Files for Bankruptcy
coverage.summary: Poolin Technology Pte. Ltd., the Singapore-based company that once ran one of Bitcoin's largest mining pools, filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy on July 22 in the U.S. Bankruptcy Court for the District of New Jersey, with Thor CALAP LLC placing a $52 million stalking-horse bid for Poolin's two West Texas mining sites to repay 11,700 IOU-holding users.
